decisions.reason: The sewer pipe cleaning box builds directly on the firm's fluid-handling fabrication for utilities, and after only one year its prospects are still uncertain, so keeping this cheap option open is sensible.

Public waste bins are distant from the core offer and riskier, but they use existing steel and coating skills and reach public-sector buyers the firm already serves, so the low carrying cost justifies waiting for more evidence before dropping them.
Ground sleeves for posts are a simple extension of standard metal components with a low cost to keep listed, and one year gives too little information to abandon them.
Cast iron ground sleeves complete a related product family alongside the steel version, and keeping the variant open costs little while demand is still being revealed.
Steel ground sleeves fit the firm's steel processing and in-house surface treatment strengths, so the option stays open at minimal cost.
